Compare the HP and the modified HP filter

Source: R/batch.R
mhp_compare.Rd

mhp_compare() filters one series with the HP filter at the conventional \(\lambda\) of its frequency and with the modified HP filter, and compares the cycles; batch_compare() does the same for every column of a matrix.

Usage

mhp_compare(
  x,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 100000L
)

# Default S3 method
mhp_compare(
  x,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 100000L
)

batch_compare(
  X,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 100000L
)

# Default S3 method
batch_compare(
  X,
  frequency = c("quarterly", "annual", "monthly"),
  max_lambda = 100000L
)

Arguments

x

a numeric vector or a ts object, without missing values; at least 5 observations.

frequency

"quarterly" (default), "annual" or "monthly".

max_lambda

the largest \(\lambda\) of the search over \(1, 2, \dots,\) max_lambda (default 100000).

X

a numeric matrix or data frame, one series per column.

Value

mhp_compare(): a data.table with one row per method (HP, Modified HP) and the columns method, lambda, cycle_sd, cycle_mean, ar1, cycle_range, gcv. batch_compare(): a data.table with one row per series and the columns series, hp_lambda, mhp_lambda, hp_cycle_sd, mhp_cycle_sd, sd_diff, hp_ar1, mhp_ar1, ar1_diff, relative_sd.

Details

The conventional values are \(\lambda = 1600\) (quarterly), 100 (annual) and 129600 (monthly, Ravn and Uhlig 2002). ar1 is the first-order autocorrelation of the cycle, \(\sum_t c_t c_{t+1} / \sum_t c_t^2\).

See also

fmhp_compare, plot_comparison

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(us_macro)
cmp <-
  mhp_compare(
      x          = log(us_macro$gdp)
    , frequency  = "quarterly"
    , max_lambda = 100000
    )
cmp
#>         method lambda   cycle_sd    cycle_mean       ar1 cycle_range
#>         <char>  <num>      <num>         <num>     <num>       <num>
#> 1:          HP   1600 0.01543904  4.942713e-12 0.8668207  0.08590516
#> 2: Modified HP    683 0.01333176 -1.634336e-13 0.8280266  0.07801575
#>             gcv
#>           <num>
#> 1:           NA
#> 2: 0.0002819926
bc <-
  batch_compare(
      X          = log(as.matrix(us_macro[, c("gdp", "consumption", "investment")]))
    , frequency  = "quarterly"
    , max_lambda = 100000
    )
bc
#>         series hp_lambda mhp_lambda hp_cycle_sd mhp_cycle_sd      sd_diff
#>         <char>     <num>      <int>       <num>        <num>        <num>
#> 1:         gdp      1600        683  0.01543904   0.01333176 -0.002107273
#> 2: consumption      1600        534  0.01241982   0.01000618 -0.002413639
#> 3:  investment      1600       1009  0.07189806   0.06760443 -0.004293628
#>       hp_ar1   mhp_ar1    ar1_diff relative_sd
#>        <num>     <num>       <num>       <num>
#> 1: 0.8668207 0.8280266 -0.03879413   0.8635101
#> 2: 0.8779254 0.8231665 -0.05475890   0.8056623
#> 3: 0.8143287 0.7914367 -0.02289200   0.9402817
